d:
Israil men hue sansdiy chunav men israil ki arab partiyon ki siten barhi hain. aise men israil ki arab partiyan agli sarkar ke gathan men kingmekar ban sakti hain.
Halanki, arab partiyon ka prabhav is bat par nirbhar karega ki vipakshi neta unki bhagidari ya sarkar se bahar rahte hue unka samarthan svikar karte hain ya nahin. arab partiyan israil men sarkar gathan ko kaise prabhavit kar sakti hain? in arab partiyon ki kya ahmiyat hai?
Aaj pahli khabar men isi ki bat.
